title.narrative: Equal rooting - Greater gender equality in Palestine
Equal rooting - Greater gender equality in Palestine

description.narrative:
Overall goal: Contributing to greater gender equality in Palestine: addressing the root causes of discrimination and violence and promoting the recognition and full exercise of women's rights in West Bank and Gaza Strip
Result 1: Increased access to specialized, survivor-centered services, especially Sexual and Reproductive Health and GBV multi-sectoral protection services
Result 2: Promoted actions for women's economic autonomy and women's economic rights
Result 3: Strengthened the capacities of women to exercise their active citizenship by reinforcing their role as advocacy agents in the promotion of their rights

Programmet avser att bidra till att främja jämställdhet i Palestina genom ett omfattande program baserat på tre resultat: 1: Ökad tillgång till specialiserade, efterlevandecentrerade tjänster, särskilt sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och multisektoriella skyddstjänster för GBV. 2: Främjade åtgärder för kvinnors ekonomiska autonomi och kvinnors ekonomiska rättigheter. 3: Stärkt kvinnors kapacitet att utöva sitt aktiva medborgarskap genom att stärka deras roll som förespråkare för att främja deras rättigheter.

The programme intends to contribute to foster gender equality in the Palestine through a comprehensive program based in three results: 1: Increased access to specialized, survivor-centered services, especially Sexual and Reproductive Health and GBV multisectoral protection services. 2: Promoted actions for women's economic autonomy and women´s economic rights. 3: Strengthened the capacities of women to exercise their active citizenship by reinforcing their role as advocacy agents in the promotion of their rights.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative:
Alianza and their partners have acheived results during 2023 which were presented in the annual narrative report, submitted in July 2023. In some areas they even acheived more than what was anticipated. On the other hand, in some areas the activities were delayed or postponed. The project is implemented by four partners PICTI, WATC, PFPPA and CFTA and it is based on three results areas. Some examples of what has been acheived are as follows: 1. Increased access to specialized, survivorcentered services, especially Sexual and Reproductive Health and GBV Provision of GBV services is one of the most important parts of the project and it is implemented by PFPPA and CFTA. The targeted areas have been Ramallah and Gaza. 520 GBV survivors have benefited from multisectorial services and 767 cases were provided with psychological, social, legal and health support. A total of 831 women received individual psychosocial support. 484 beneficiaries recived legal consultations. Awareness campaigns to support behavioural changes and positive masculine roles reached 2150 participant including 1085 women and 1065 men.
2. Promoted actions for women's economic autonomy and women's economic rights The activities have focused on promoting women entrepreneurs. One call for proposals was done to support green economy projects. Trainings and capacity building have been implemented, which have reached 32 women. Awareness programs have also been implemented together with CEOs and with the Chamber of Commerce.
3. Strengthed the capacities of women to exercise their active citizenship by reinforcing their role as advocacy agents in the promotion of their rights Three Community Based Organisations have received capacity building on women's rights and political participation, as well as negotiation and advocacy skills. Postassessment data demonstrated a notable improvement in participans' capacities and skills to facilitate meetings in their communities. Local campaigns were carried out, among them one about prevention of early marriages. Alianza and partners have identified the Unsafe Abortion Coalition action plan and have perfomed advocacy actions and joint campaigns with the Unsafe Abortion Coalition. The main objective is to make sure that women will have access to safe abortions. This is a very sensitive issue and demands substantial planning. Alianza and its partners are strongly committed to upholding and implementing the principles of Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA). Alianza has a set of protection policies that are mandatory for all partners.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
